ordinance_area_text: (a) The provisions of section 27-67 shall not apply to shotguns discharging pellets using number 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9 shot under the following conditions: (1) On land that is 25 acres or more of contiguous area, and (2) Used primarily for agricultural purposes, and (3) The landowner has applied for an annual permit from the chief of police to use his property for this purpose. ... (4) The landowner has agreed to allow the city's wildlife management specialists on his property to cull deer ... (5) Any person or persons discharging a shotgun as set forth above shall, at all times, ... have in his possession written permission from the landowner ... (7) 00 to #4 shot may be used in shotguns for the sole purpose of hunting deer. (8) No person or persons shall hunt deer in the city by the use of a dog or dogs. (b) No person shall discharge a shotgun within 100 yards of any building, dwelling, street, sidewalk, alley, roadway or public land or public place within the city limits.
method: Built 2026-11 from City of Lynchburg GIS (mapviewer.lynchburgva.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Assessor/ProVal/MapServer): layer 141 'Agricultural Land Use' (the assessor's use-value program areas, 77 polygons tagged Agricultural / Horticulture / Forest / '1 Square Acre' homesite, with RollBack_Date) and layer 31 'Parcels' (32,621), downloaded with outSR=4326. Lynchburg has no agricultural zoning district (zoning layer 147 has only R, B, I, IN and RC districts), so 'used primarily for agricultural purposes' can only be read from the assessor's land-use program. Per parcel, program areas were summed by category, excluding areas with a RollBack_Date (taken out of the program). Same-owner touching parcels were grouped to test the 25-contiguous-acre rule. Kept: tracts of at least 25 acres with at least 25 acres of active Agricultural/Horticultural program land: parcel 27403009 (35.9 ac, all agricultural; zoned I-2), 21702001 (59.7 ac: 29.5 ac agricultural, 26.8 ac forest; zoned B-3/R-1) and 23405002 (60.2 ac: 27.4 ac agricultural, 28.8 ac forest, 2 ac homesites; zoned R-1). Whole parcels are mapped (the 'land' the permit covers), one feature each. Simplified 1 m, rounded to 1e-5 deg. Scripts: scratchpad ord-areas/lyn.py, lyn_final.py, finalize.py.
notes: These are areas WHERE SHOTGUN HUNTING MAY BE PERMITTED, an exception to the citywide firearm-discharge ban of Sec. 27-67(a): 63 ha = 0.49% of the city. It is a candidate list, not a list of permits: the city publishes no list or map of permitted properties, and hunting there is legal only if the landowner holds the current police/Animal Control permit, the hunter carries the landowner's written permission, and the 100-yard setback in 27-67.1(b) from any building, dwelling, street, sidewalk, alley, roadway or public land is met (not applied to this polygon; on these tracts it removes a large part of the land). The city's Urban Hunting page (lynchburgvapolice.gov/urban-hunting) describes the permit as a 'Hunt Permit' issued by Animal Control for 25+ contiguous acres, 'Shotgun or bow and arrow may be used for taking deer only', 'Only 00 or #4 buckshot', shotgun only during firearms season, from an elevated position at least 12 ft high, renewed every two years, and does not mention agricultural use - stricter on species and looser on land use than the ordinance. Judgment calls: 21702001 and 23405002 are about half farm and half woods ('primarily' is borderline: agriculture is the larger use on 21702001 and slightly smaller than forest on 23405002). Excluded: 20206002/20308001 (52.7 ac, but its 28.6 ac agricultural area was rolled back out of the program in 2024), forest-dominated tracts of 25+ ac (e.g. 21806005, 21203001, 24213004, 25012001, 27501006 - eligible under the city's web description but not 'primarily agricultural'), and farms of 25+ ac not enrolled in the land-use program, which this data cannot see. The 15-acre agricultural area on parcel 01701010 is on a 19.8-acre parcel with no same-owner neighbours (under 25 acres).
